family_reports.body: This system has kept my family apart and kept my children from knowing each other and growing up together. The judges and the front of the court need to be held accountable for keeping families apart for no reason other than they don’t wanna do their job and see the evidence.

The litigation abuse and trauma from the last 5 years has resulted in me developing an autoimmune disorder. When the Defendant filed a motion to compel discovery on my daughter's 10th birthday, it suffered a TIA while responding to their motion. I have also lost jobs because of them.

public_comments.comment_text: Judge Savin has a close professional relationship with my daughter's father's attorney, through her father in law. Judge Savin allows the Defendant to get away with violating her orders but will always find a way to punish me. When I testified to the ways that my daughter's father abused me and threatened me, his attorney wanted it stricken from the record. The judge allowed it to be stricken. The judge has allowed burdensome attorney fees to be awards that I have to pay. I lost my attorney as a result. Whatever Candyce asks for her client, the Judge gives it to her. Candyce recently lied in her motion, claiming I never provided proof of my financial situation. I supplied them with my Unemployment certifications. I put in my response to their motion that its a violation of the code of ethics and that Candyce Abbatt should be sanctioned. Judge Savin refused to do it and claimed that she didnt misled the court. Judge Savin’s father in law is close professional friends with my daughter's father's attorney. She is acting from bias.
